statement: Official Russian and Ukrainian government delegations hold at least one in-person negotiating session on ending or pausing the war, bilaterally or with mediators present, between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if official sources on both the Russian and Ukrainian sides confirm an in-person negotiating session attended by delegations of both governments, held between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-30. Prisoner-exchange technical contacts alone do not count.
failure_condition: No in-person negotiating session attended by official delegations of both Russia and Ukraine takes place between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-30.

statement: Israel or the United States carries out an air, missile, or drone strike on targets inside Iranian territory between 2026-10-23 and 2026-12-31, and the government that carried it out publicly acknowledges it.
resolution: TRUE if the Israeli government or IDF, or the US government, publicly acknowledges conducting an air, missile, or drone strike on Iranian territory that occurred between 2026-10-23 and 2026-12-31; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No air, missile, or drone strike on Iranian territory occurring between 2026-10-23 and 2026-12-31 is both carried out and acknowledged by the Israeli or US government.

statement: A Houthi missile or drone attack on Saudi Arabian territory kills at least one person between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-22.
resolution: TRUE if the Saudi Press Agency, or at least two of Reuters, AP and AFP, report one or more deaths on Saudi territory caused by a Houthi attack occurring between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-22; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No Houthi attack occurring between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-22 causes a death on Saudi Arabian territory.

statement: The WTI crude spot price (FRED series DCOILWTICO) records a daily value at or above 110.00 USD per barrel on at least one date between 2026-10-23 and 2026-12-31. Reference: WTI 98.51 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DCOILWTICO shows any daily value dated between 2026-10-23 and 2026-12-31 at or above 110.00; otherwise FALSE. Reference: 98.51 on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every DCOILWTICO daily value dated between 2026-10-23 and 2026-12-31 is below 110.00 USD per barrel.

statement: CISA adds at least one PHP vulnerability (KEV vendorProject PHP, such as the PHP2Shell flaws) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog lists an entry with vendorProject PHP whose dateAdded falls between 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-20 inclusive; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: CISA has not added any vulnerability with vendorProject PHP to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-20.

statement: CISA adds at least one GitLab vulnerability (KEV vendorProject GitLab), such as the CVSS 10.0 flaw reported on 2026-10-21, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog lists an entry with vendorProject GitLab whose dateAdded falls between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31 inclusive; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: CISA has not added any vulnerability with vendorProject GitLab to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 of the 435 US House of Representatives seats in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: TRUE if certified state results, or AP race calls where certification is pending, show Democratic candidates winning 218 or more of 435 House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates win 217 or fewer of the 435 House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election.

statement: California Proposition 40, the billionaire wealth tax measure, is approved by voters in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: TRUE if the certified Statement of Vote from the California Secretary of State shows more Yes than No votes on Proposition 40 in the 2026-11-03 general election; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Proposition 40 does not receive more Yes than No votes in the certified results of the 2026-11-03 California general election.

statement: A court dismisses every criminal charge against Virginia state Senator L. Louise Lucas, in the case reported on 2026-10-22, by an order entered between 2026-10-23 and 2027-04-13.
resolution: TRUE if the court docket in the criminal case against L. Louise Lucas records an order dismissing every charge against her, entered between 2026-10-23 and 2027-04-13; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No order dismissing every charge against Lucas is entered between 2026-10-23 and 2027-04-13.

statement: An earthquake of USGS magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 100 km of the epicenter of USGS event us6000u43g, the M7.0 east-northeast of Nagqu, China, between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-21 UTC.
resolution: TRUE if USGS ComCat lists an event with preferred magnitude 6.0 or greater, origin time between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-21 UTC, and epicenter within 100 km of event us6000u43g; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 100 km of the us6000u43g epicenter between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-21 UTC.
